title: Smoke scope counts a model as RUN when all its ops were skipped (Qwen 2.1 read as proven)
description: MPI-1043 Noticed (2026-10-08): scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs scope builder counts qwen-image-2-1 as run although both its ops SKIPped (workflow not landed), so dev_configs/smoke-evidence.json has scope.unproven [] and release:check prints 'covers all 40 models' while Qwen 2.1 never executed. Fix: a model with zero executed ops lands in unproven. Fabio tested Qwen 2.1 on RunPod by hand 2026-10-10, so the gap is closed in fact, not in the evidence file. Umbrella MPI-1064.
